title: Operations Dashboard for Managing AI Workflows and Moderation
summary: A secure control panel for turning workflows on and off, monitoring executions and moderating Instagram conversations.
headline: One control panel for every AI workflow
problem: The team needed one place to run and watch many AI automations, without opening each tool.
solution: I built a Vite dashboard hosted on Vercel with Supabase login. It activates and deactivates workflows, pins priorities, shows executions and logs, and tracks and moderates Instagram comments and threads.
highlights: Comment tracking, threads and deletion tools
role: Sole engineer. I built the entire dashboard and its integrations.
